items.title: Special cancellation right due to price increase
items.quote: Damit die Kündigung wirkt, muss sie bei uns vor dem Inkrafttreten der neuen Preise eingehen.
items.computation: The letter grants a special right to terminate the contract without notice effective 01.01.2027, the date the new, higher prices take effect. The cancellation must reach the provider 'vor dem Inkrafttreten der neuen Preise', i.e. before 01.01.2027. The last calendar day before 01.01.2027 is 31.12.2026, a Thursday and not a public holiday in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed. Therefore the cancellation must arrive at the provider by 31.12.2026 at the latest.
